rationale.consistency: Seamlessly integrates with the existing CLI structure, GraphQL queries, and httpmock patterns.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles markdown and file path edge cases well, but fails the requirement to abort on partial upload failures.
rationale.scope: Strictly implements the requested feature set without unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: The markdown byte-level AST manipulation is dense but reasonably well-structured.
rationale.robustness: Violates transactionality by intentionally proceeding to create or update issues/PRs even if an upload fails midway.
rationale.maintainability: The new attachments package encapsulates the logic nicely, keeping command handlers clean.
